required_data_meanings: Gene identity for every column and a scientifically supported column order.
Ten named tissue-region groups for each of the Fetal and Paediatric groups.
Mean-expression values for every gene by region and age group, together with the normalization that makes the visible 0-1 color key meaningful.
One cosine-similarity value per aligned gene, including a definition of the two vectors compared.
Interaction-effect P values or threshold classes per gene, including their model, test, correction, and independent units.
A supplied dendrogram or enough clustering information to support its topology and heights.
A supplied explanation for orange gene labels and the two black outlined column groups.

Interaction-effect model, statistical test, correction, and exact P values.
Dendrogram metric, linkage, input representation, precise merge heights, leaf-order algorithm, and colored-branch cut rule.
